content.short: Dapp that helps Restaurants, Brands and Foodies to connect each other and create a small economy based on F&B.
content.description: Dapp that allows you to discover Restaurants based on your taste and share your culinary Experiences with a community of Foodies. ‍ We aim to create a platform decentralized with a social network and Web3 restaurant reservation, to appropriately evaluate the search of restaurants, through photos and reviews of every food lover. We would like to be a reliable new innovative Michelin Guide! Dapp that allows you to discover Restaurants based on your taste and share your culinary Experiences with a community of Foodies.
